title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #9

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is one of the five great elements? (1 mark)
   A. Wood
   B. Salt
   C. Metal
   D. Akash

2. How did Prahlad react when his father was angry? (1 mark)
   A. He became cruel
   B. He ran away forever
   C. He stayed calm and kept his faith
   D. He gave up praying

3. What should you do if your knees hurt in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Stop and come out of the pose
   B. Ignore it
   C. Push harder
   D. Stay for an hour

4. Which festival is a national festival? (1 mark)
   A. Paryushan Parva
   B. Madaraka Day
   C. Vasant Panchami
   D. Maha Shivratri

5. What is the correct way to sit for Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Slouching
   B. With a straight back and relaxed body
   C. Standing on one leg
   D. Lying on the stomach

6. Ravi is another name for which heavenly body? (1 mark)
   A. The Sun
   B. Mars
   C. The Moon
   D. Venus

7. How should learners who return lost items be treated? (1 mark)
   A. They should be thanked
   B. They should be laughed at
   C. They should be ignored
   D. They should be punished

8. What does pita mean in the prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Wealth
   B. Friend
   C. Father
   D. Mother

9. Which of these is a month of the Indian traditional calendar? (1 mark)
   A. Chaitra
   B. January
   C. March
   D. June

10. Which of these is one of Parshvanath's four rules? (1 mark)
   A. Satya, always speak the truth
   B. Wealth at any cost
   C. Be proud
   D. Take what you like

11. What does Ahimsa mean? (1 mark)
   A. Telling stories
   B. Eating late
   C. Paying taxes
   D. Not hurting any living being

12. In what language was the Ramayan first written? (1 mark)
   A. English
   B. Gurmukhi
   C. Sanskrit
   D. Kiswahili

13. For how many years was Ram asked to live in the forest? (1 mark)
   A. Fifty
   B. Five
   C. Fourteen
   D. Two

14. Which mistake is common about Maha Shivratri? (1 mark)
   A. Knowing it is for Shiva
   B. Thinking it is the same as Diwali
   C. Knowing it is in Phalguna
   D. Knowing about fasting

15. The soil in a shamba belongs to which element? (1 mark)
   A. Vayu
   B. Prithvi
   C. Akash
   D. Agni

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Why should we respect others who have different beliefs about death? (3 marks)

17. State what the Gayatri Mantra asks God to give us. (2 marks)

18. Write the Indian names for Sunday and Monday. (2 marks)

19. Why are Enlightened Beings considered inspiring? Use two examples. (5 marks)

20. Describe how the Bodhi tree is linked with the Buddha. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Akash
   The five elements are Prithvi, Jal, Agni, Vayu and Akash.

2. C — He stayed calm and kept his faith
   Prahlad kept his faith without fear.

3. A — Stop and come out of the pose
   Do not force the body.

4. B — Madaraka Day
   It is celebrated by all Kenyans.

5. B — With a straight back and relaxed body
   A straight back helps breathing.

6. A — The Sun
   Ravi is the Sun.

7. A — They should be thanked
   Thanking encourages honesty.

8. C — Father
   Pita means father.

9. A — Chaitra
   Chaitra is the first month.

10. A — Satya, always speak the truth
   Satya means truthfulness.

11. D — Not hurting any living being
   Ahimsa is non-violence in thought, word and action.

12. C — Sanskrit
   It was written in Sanskrit by Valmiki.

13. C — Fourteen
   Kaikeyi asked that Ram go for fourteen years.

14. B — Thinking it is the same as Diwali
   They are different festivals.

15. B — Prithvi
   Soil is earth, or Prithvi.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: People hold different views, listening with respect keeps peace, and arguing does not help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: That the divine light guide our minds toward what is good and true (wisdom).
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for wisdom or guidance of the mind.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Sunday: Ravivaar. Monday: Somvaar.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

19. (5 marks)
   Answer: Their lives show courage, kindness and truth. For example, Prahlad's faith and Siddhartha's kindness to the swan. People follow their example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason, 2 marks for each example, up to 5.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Prince Siddhartha sat under a Bodhi tree at Bodh Gaya and became the Buddha, the Awakened One. Buddhists honour the tree because of this.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the tree, 1 mark for Siddhartha, 1 mark for enlightenment or Bodh Gaya.
